source.name: FC Schalke 04: BEUMER Group to become FC Schalke 04's new main partner
source.quote: BEUMER Group will become FC Schalke 04’s new main partner from the 2026/27 season. The deal brings together two partners whose roots and ambitions make them a perfect fit.

source.name: FC Schalke 04: Inspired by the Arena, made for the Arena: S04 unveil new home kit
source.note: The club's kit launch. It describes the whole home kit: the badge and the adidas logo on the chest, BEUMER below, BLÅKLÄDER on the left sleeve, a VELTINS-Arena graphic on the back of the neck, and white shorts and blue socks. It names no other sponsor.
source.quote: Main sponsor BEUMER also features in white below, while the BLÅKLÄDER logo appears on the left sleeve.

source.name: Schalke 04 Fanshop (shop.schalke04.de): adidas Heimtrikot 2026/2027
source.note: Kit maker. The club shop's 2026/27 home-shirt product page: adidas logo on the right chest, BEUMER central on the chest, BLÅKLÄDER on the left sleeve.
source.quote: Auf der rechten Brust befindet sich das gestickte adidas-Logo in Weiß

summary: adidas home shirt: BEUMER Group on the front, Blåkläder on the left sleeve. The club's kit launch names no other sponsor on the shirt or the shorts; the back of the neck carries a graphic of the VELTINS-Arena for its 25th anniversary. BEUMER Group is family-owned, Blåkläder is owned by the Gustavsson family, adidas is a listed company.
